name: Mindshaper
body:
Your mind overpowers the thoughts of the weak-willed.

Prerequisite: Greater Spell Focus (enchantment), Spell Focus (enchantment)

Benefit: You gain a +1 bonus to the save DC of enchantment spells and spell-like abilities. Additionally, you gain a +1 bonus to overcome spell resistance when casting an enchantment spell or spell-like ability.
